name: classic-freedom-engine
description: Deterministic Classic→Freedom merge engine + mapper (runtime only). Golden runners + fixtures live in the repo-root engine-tests/classic-to-freedom (outside the shipped skill). The vendored acorn parser is the CommonJS build (vendor/acorn.cjs), loaded via a plain synchronous require() after the integrity check — so there is NO raised Node floor (works on the repo's Node 20 baseline and up).
